import html # Example template; in real use this would be defined elsewhere INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def prepare_event_details(headline: str, summary: str, scheduled_date: str, additional_info: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure, sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or name of the event. summary : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date of the event. additional_info : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the organizer. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for safe display. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS escaped_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) escaped_summary = html.escape(summary, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') escaped_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(additional_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Format the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_headline, event_description=escaped_summary, event_date=escaped_date, additional_notes=escaped_notes ) return invitation_html
